title: saved decision corpus
description: Shared by TestSavedDecisionCorpusPrompts and TestSavedDecisionCorpusDecisions (backend/internal/worker/agent/providers), which read each request into the stated prompt and rebuild each response from the stated decision, and frontend/src/components/chat/savedDecisionCorpus.test.ts, which reads each prompt and decision through the shared saved-answer display and requires the label.

requestId.description: The id under which the Worker stores the request, which the answer addresses.

prompt.description: A leapmux.v1.ControlPrompt in protojson, as the Worker records it.

decision.description: A leapmux.v1.ControlDecision in protojson, as the Worker records it beside the prompt.

permissionModeLabels.description: The labels of the agent's permission modes that the browser holds, by mode value.
